rationale: Resolve Doral Renewables and Doral Renewables LLC as one legal company, with Doral Renewables LLC retained as the canonical name. Official company and regulatory materials identify the business as formerly Global Energy Generation LLC and doing business as Doral LLC. APG Asset Management's 2024 infrastructure-equity investment on behalf of Stichting Pensioenfonds ABP closed and remains active; Doral's filed financial statements report ABP/APG at 40%, the current company site continues to identify APG as a sponsor, and no APG sale or exit was found. May 2026 discussions concerning a future Doral Group equity raise and acquisition of Clean Air Generation's interest were neither signed nor completed and do not change APG's current-owner status. Correct the canonical aliases, company website, Philadelphia headquarters, APG/ABP stake, verification date, and directly supported identity and ownership milestones. The separate Apollo census candidate is the same company, but Apollo's disclosed exposure was convertible-note financing and Apollo is absent from Doral's filed common-equity holder list; it therefore does not qualify as a current ownership period and its later duplicate task should be superseded by this resolved decision.
